decisions.reason: The rejection interchanges the two genus-one gluings. On E_U the meridian is lambda_U and the longitude is mu_U. A meridional disk twist sends mu_U+lambda_U to mu_U. Identifying an attached meridian with this exterior longitude exchanges the two factor circles in the boundary of D2 x D2 and gives S3; matching exterior meridians gives S1 x S2. Thus Verification 2.2 is correct, as is 2.1.

Conjugacy of meridian loops alone would not determine the parallel, but the cited lem-wirtinger-local-meridian-conjugacy Proof 1.1 explicitly constructs alpha_s, alpha_t and the upper push-off beta. It proves alpha_s beta alpha_t^-1 is the positive over-meridian by a positive-winding triangle homotopy avoiding both strands, hence alpha_in beta = g_o alpha_out. Its Proof 2.1 uses the same paths for meridian transport. The present Proof 3.1 cites that access-path calculation, so it is not inferring the path identity merely from conjugacy. Underpasses 1,3,2 give b,a,c and therefore w=bac; the claimed longitude and +1 relation follow.
